answer: A farm that owns the submitting key cannot also own the verifiers, because each one must be independent on the anchor graph and each exposes its bond to the juniper slash if it rubber-stamps. Since disagreement burns everyone the epoch, the nebula audit records every split and the operator cannot buy agreement cheaply. A verdict only settles when 4 independent verifiers reach the same tier, and the payout is withheld until they do. That is 24 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
